What I do

Proper prep.
Proper finish.

Covering most aspects of alloy refurbs, all done on site, at your home or your workplace. Not sure what your wheels need? Send a photo and I'll tell you.

01

Colour change

Five to eight hours of prep on your wheels so the finish lasts, then primer, paint and a thick coat of lacquer that flows like glass.

02

Diamond cut replication

Either take the kerb damage out and spray a very bright silver, then lacquer, or sand the whole face, prep the grey or black part and re-lacquer it all. It saves you money.

03

Smart repairs

Kerbed, scuffed or scratched? Affordable repairs done at your home or your workplace.

04

Powder coating

Part of a full wheel restoration, built to last longer.

05

Welds and buckle repairs

Alloy welds and buckle repairs for wheels that need more than paint.

How a colour change goes

Photo to
glass finish

  1. Send a photo

    WhatsApp a picture of the wheel. If you can't, just ring. That's how I quote.

  2. I come to you

    Home or workplace, I arrive at the property and do the work there.

  3. Prep, 5 to 8 hours

    The boring bit that decides how long it lasts. Nothing is rushed.

  4. Primer and paint

    Primers, then paint in the colour you picked.

  5. Lacquer like glass

    A thick coat of lacquer to finish, so it flows like glass.
